children.text:
Swedish massage is a classic full-body therapy designed to promote deep relaxation, improve circulation, and ease muscle tension using a combination of manual techniques by a trained massage therapist. At King Spa, we offer an authentic Swedish style massage in Virginia that blends gentle strokes with expert pressure to provide both physical and mental relief.

Our therapists use five foundational Swedish massage techniques:

heading.html:
Maximize Your Results:
Before & After Your Swedish Massage

children.text: To fully benefit from your Swedish massage therapy, we recommend a few simple steps before and after your treatment.

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-5622508c elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.html:
Stay hydrated


Drinking water helps prepare your muscles and supports circulation.

Arrive early


Give yourself time to relax and check in without rushing.

Avoid heavy meals


A light snack is fine, but a full stomach may cause discomfort during the session.

Communicate with your therapist


Let them know your pressure preferences and any areas of tension or concern.

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-642508be elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.html:
Drink plenty of water


Hydration helps flush out toxins released during the massage.

Take it easy


Allow your body to rest and absorb the benefits of the session.

Stretch gently


Light movement can help extend the effects of improved flexibility and muscle release.

Avoid strenuous activity


Give your muscles time to relax and recover.

children.html:
Vanessa Phillips

I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler

Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna

I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.
Megan Durst

I've gone with my small group multiple times and with my spouse and we all thoroughly enjoy it. I usually get the body scrub because who doesn't like their skin feeling like a baby's skin? And the ice bath has become one of my favorite parts, but I've always enjoyed the variety of saunas and bade pool, and the outdoor pool(and hot tub, and bridge) is beautiful & can be relaxing too(Just maybe not on a Saturday when it's busy😅). Definitely going back.
Mykyla J

This place was AMAZING, i stepped out of many comfort zones by going here. Things are a little confusing if you are getting the body scrub service, but there were other people there who helped even if the staff couldn't. Everybody was so friendly. I will continue to keep coming back. It's a 4 hour drive from where i stay, but it is worth the drive. I will also bring other people back along with me spreading the word of this amazing place !!!
Asel Dav

King Spa in Chantilly, VA, is a Korean-inspired spa offering a range of wellness and relaxation services. It features various saunas, including traditional Korean heated rooms, salt rooms, and cold rooms, designed to promote detoxification and relaxation. Additionally, King Spa offers body scrubs, massages, and other therapeutic treatments. The spa also includes amenities such as pools, relaxation lounges, and dining options, making it a comprehensive destination for a rejuvenating experience. This is my favorite place to relax… Highly recommend it, you will love this place ❤️

heading.html: FAQ: Swedish Massage at King Spa

children.html:
What should I do to prepare for my Swedish massage?
Stay hydrated, avoid heavy meals, and arrive early to relax. Let your therapist know about any areas of tension or pressure preferences.
What should I wear during the massage?
You may undress to your comfort level. Our therapists use professional draping techniques to ensure your privacy and comfort throughout the session.
Is Swedish massage painful?
No—Swedish massage uses gentle to moderate pressure. It’s designed to relax the body, not to cause discomfort. If you ever feel pain, let your therapist know so they can adjust.
How often should I get a Swedish massage?
Many clients benefit from monthly sessions, while others come more often during stressful periods or recovery phases. Your therapist can recommend a schedule based on your needs.
What’s the difference between Swedish massage and deep tissue massage?
Swedish massage is gentler, focusing on relaxation and overall circulation. Deep tissue massage uses more pressure to target deeper muscle layers and chronic tension.
Are there any health conditions that would prevent me from getting a Swedish massage?
Most people can safely enjoy Swedish massage, but if you have a medical condition (like recent surgery, blood clots, or certain heart conditions), check with your doctor first.
How do I book a Swedish massage at King Spa?
Swedish massage appointments are booked on-site only and are offered on a first-come, first-served basis. We recommend arriving early to secure your preferred time.
What other types of massage does King Spa offer?
We offer various types of massages for men, women, and couples. Explore all of King Spa’s massage therapy services.
